This page lists 126 Adobe Premiere Pro keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `premiere-pro.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe Premiere Pro to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t premiere-pro.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/premiere-pro.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe Premiere Pro 2024/Adobe Premiere Pro 2024.app`; if Adobe Premiere Pro lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## File

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘N` | New Project |
| `⌘N` | New Sequence |
| `⌘O` | Open Project |
| `⌘W` | Close |
| `⇧⌘W` | Close Project |
| `⌘S` | Save |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save As |
| `⌥⌘S` | Save a Copy |
| `⌥⌘I` | Import from Media Browser |
| `⌘I` | Import |
| `⌘M` | Export Media |
| `⌥⇧M` | Send to Media Encoder |
| `⇧⌘H` | Get Media File Properties |
| `⌘Q` | Exit |

## Program Monitor

Select graphic layer first for nudging.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘R` | Show Rulers |
| `⌘;` | Show Guides |
| `⇧⌘;` | Snap in Program Monitor |
| `⌥⇧⌘R` | Lock Guides |
| `⌘↑↓←→` | Nudge by one frame |
| `⇧⌘↑↓←→` | Nudge by five frames |

## Timeline

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌫` | Clear Selection |
| `⌥-` | Decrease Audio Tracks Height |
| `⌘-` | Decrease Video Tracks Height |
| `⌥=` | Increase Audio Tracks Height |
| `⌘=` | Increase Video Tracks Height |
| `⌘←` | Nudge Clip Left One Frame |
| `⌘→` | Nudge Clip Right One Frame |
| `⇧⌘←` | Nudge Clip Left Five Frames |
| `⇧⌘→` | Nudge Clip Right Five Frames |
| `⌥⌫` | Ripple Delete |
| `⌥[` | Set Work Area Bar In Point |
| `⌥]` | Set Work Area Bar Out Point |

## Template file

The full [`premiere-pro.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/premiere-pro.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
